profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Focused and detailed oriented Software Engineer capable of both frontend and backend development as well as offering exceptional troubleshooting skills as a part of a programming team. A talent and a passion for developing innovative solutions to difficult problems, thinking outside of the box to bring new ideas to the challenges facing the team.  Easily adapts to situations with an ability to do great work while under pressure.  I am also a highly dependable and passionate team player dedicated to streamlining processes and working with the team to efficiently resolve project issues.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Design · Engineering · Software Industry · Web Engineering · Agile Methodologies · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Microservices

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Focused on development of new applications and interfaces for the eCommerce platform
• Created a windows service that downloads data from an email and uses it to create an excel report.
• Coded application components using a test-driven approach.
• Helped create .NET Core Web API application that pulls data from AS400 and sends it to Insite, an eCommerce platform.
• Participated in creating and maintaining Azure WebJobs that updates information to Insite.
• Added a new functionality in our eCommerce platform to assign roles and permissions to users.
• Created business friendly system architecture documentation
• Found creative solutions for identified issues that met the business needs without compromising existing system functionality.
• Contributed to the building of the CICD pipeline using Azure DevOps, streamlining development efforts
• Created and maintained automated tests as part of coding effort, including them into the CICD pipeline

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Worked as a part of a 5 person Agile Scrum team focused on development of custom solutions for PayNet's customers.
• Participated in designing and development of software using agile development practices
• Coded application components using a test-driven approach
• Helped migrate the company's reporting engine tool, which is Pentaho to Pentaho 6.0
• Added enhancements to PayNet's application using C#, JavaScript, Jquery, and SQL.
• Wrote SQL queries and created stored procedures to create Pentaho reports.
• Help create a single page application using Angular 2 and MVC.

positions.title: Clearing System Support
positions.description:
As a member of the application support and maintenance team worked with a team of 5
• Provide superior support and incident resolution for the Clearing Services Production environment including the upkeep and validation of procedure and environment documentation.
• Assist with system maintenance including change implementation for the clearing services production environment.
• Participate in Incident Management & Change Management procedures
• Create and update clearing support documentation and procedures.
• Provide after hours and weekend support

positions.title: Support and Development
positions.description:
Was responsible for being the primary support developer for 2 applications.
• Receive customer support requests. Classify issues and work with other developers to resolve non-trivial issues.
• Added enhancements to Urgent's application, eMaintenance using VB.Net, JavaScript, ASP.Net and SQL. One of the enhancements that I did was enabling a user to change an account on a certain ticket.
• Made some changes to eMaintenance IVR system.
• Wrote SQL queries and created stored procedures to create reports for BP staff.

positions.title: Support Engineer
positions.description:
Provided tier 2 support to customers using Aceyus call center application
• Receive customer support requests. Classify issues and work with developers to resolve non-trivial issues.
• Created a C# application that connects to the Microsoft SQL server. This application can add, delete, and update a table without opening the Microsoft SQL server application.
• Updated their .Net application for ticketing system. The application can view notes from the person who worked the ticket.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Create scripts to get key data points, assisting researchers in accessing desired information more readily.
• Responsible for the creation and maintenance of data transformation scripts for the web of science project.
• Wrote python scripts to parse structured source files from Thompson Reuters, which are proprietary tagged format into a column delimeted text which can be loaded into a relational database.
• Troubleshoot some of the python scripts that they have for it is not parsing the write information.
